title: HILARIOUS New Ad EXPOSES Trump's Fake Outrage Over Biden Calling Trump Supporters GARBAGE
description:
In a powerful new ad, The Lincoln Project highlights the hypocrisy of MAGA outrage over President Joe Biden’s recent “garbage” comment about Trump supporters who laughed at racist jokes during Trump's Madison Square Garden rally. For nearly a decade, Trump and his supporters have openly mocked others and hurled offensive comments without issue. Now, when Biden points out their behavior, they claim to be offended. This video dives into The Lincoln Project’s ad, breaking down the double standards and comparing the MAGA mindset to George Orwell's classic "1984," where people are manipulated to create alternate realities that serve their "Party." Watch as we dissect the twisted irony and explore how far-right loyalty can cloud logic and ethics. Don’t miss the analysis of how the MAGA movement mirrors Orwellian principles.
